I told Hollis the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47.

- **Where it comes from:** On Oct 14 Pree posted Dock 23 in #central-team, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning because she'd read the wrong line. Nothing in #central-team has changed it since.
- **What Hollis can see:** He's a member of #central-team, so he can see both of Pree's posts. The site is an operational detail, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
- **My reply:** In his thread in #central-team I posted: "Hollis, it's Gate 47. Pree first posted Dock 23 here on Oct 14, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning because she'd read the wrong line. Nothing in the channel has changed it since, so put Gate 47 on the account sheet, not Dock 23."
